description: This file defines the interface for the Telco Voice Manager's network monitoring component. It contains include guards, conditional includes based on feature flags, and declarations of initialization, closure, and creation functions related to network monitoring.

methods.name: voicemgr_sysevent_init
methods.description: Initializes the system event component of the Voice Manager.

methods.name: voicemgr_sysevent_close
methods.description: Closes or releases resources associated with the system event component.

methods.name: voicemgr_create_nw_monitor
methods.description: Creates or initializes the network monitoring component.
